notes.title: Update V 1.8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/247f643e2584b40a0374b6837b8329eba54e55fd.png
Centralia Homecoming to exit early access today.
What was added in update 1.8
- You can upgrade weapons
- Achievements in steam
- 10 new items
- Cabinets are no longer empty
- Points system
- Secrets
- Additional puzzles
- An opening cell has been added to the hospital
- Chests
- Hacking system
- 15 new sounds
- 15 new models
- Gems that can be sold
- food
- Inventory changed
And much more.

notes.title: Update V 1.4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/22fa350fd169813dbec97f9d65ffb742f42f9d11.gif
- High-quality animation of death, a new video alert.
- Added reload of any weapon
- Shot slope animations
- 15 new animations of the main character
- Added torso model
- Starvation in zombies, now the hungrier the zombies, the faster they move
- 3 new zombie animations
- Improved AI, now zombies patrol the terrain
- 4 new zombie audio
- Tricky artificial intelligence, now if zombies hear you: they can wait around the corner, or jump abruptly from around the corner, or when the door opens
- Fixed camera rotation
- Fixed a collision in store No. 1 near the save
- Optimization + 10%
- Added audio 2
- Also fixed code panels, intercoms and safes.

notes.title: Update v 1.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/0a8a2c3aac60d67e04dc5035a8c629bd30520b23.jpg
- Completely redesigned collision of cabinets, the main character no longer gets stuck in open cabinets and bedside tables
- Increased inventory
- More first aid kits and cartridge
- Increased map marker
- Fixed a collision in the police station
- Fixed not clear decapitation of zombies
- New special effect for zombies
- Fixed the first cut scene with a demon
- Balanced damage for SVD
- Balanced AI damage
- Zombie bite time reduced from 3-2 seconds
- Fixed fuzzy display of weapons near the walls
- Added character death animation
- Clearer display of dodging
- Added new zombie animation
- Changed animation height to crouch

notes.title: Update v 1.04
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/4302c0c62e726253f61fb28290b657215d562f3e.gif
- Fixed a collision.
- Fixed a bug with zombies when he remained standing.
- Changed Monster at school.
- Added new special effects.
- Changed the speed of monsters at school, from 600-800
- Increased monster health at school, from 400-450
- Improved monsters animations and shaders at school.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/18e88702ba1810e65f29fd6c35ea199b4e267bca.jpg
- Reduced bullet spread. Now the main character shoots more accurately.
- Fixed wallpaper when loading.
- Fixed a bug with the inscription when saving.
- Increased zombie health, from 250-300.
- Improved AI navigation.

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/d9ed6491c92289f253584bfed4cd14cceaa3e469.gif
The AI of the ghost enemies has been improved, in addition they have received a new 3d model, an improved behavior tree, better animations, additional QTE systems and many other improvements.

Added:
Additional Notes.
More Medkits.
More Ammo.

The AI has been improved.
